description: Render the first 20 pages of a PDF as JPG or PNG images (100/150/220 dpi). One base64 image per page. Runs on our server, files are deleted right after the call, nothing stored. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €15/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.005/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/pdf-to-image.
